Name: Utility Support Slot
Description: Carry a Solo Silo designator or C4 detonator alongside another support weapon. Choose normal support controls or a separate Utility Weapon keybind. Pickups follow the game's Switch Weapon On Pickup setting. Requires Bingus Shared Loader (tested with v19). Mod Options Menu and Mod Bindings Menu are optional.

Options.Name: Core
Options.Description: Required for the mod to work. Enable Core, then choose one binding mode below.

Options.Name: Bindings
Options.Description: Choose how you switch to your utility weapon.

SubOptions.Name: Default Bindings
SubOptions.Description: Swap between your utility and support weapon using your normal support binding while support is drawn. On controller, hold the weapon-switch button while support is equipped.

SubOptions.Name: Dedicated Key
SubOptions.Description: Draw your utility directly with 6 by default. Change the key in utility_support_slot.ini or assign Utility Weapon through Mod Bindings Menu.
